result.topic_en: Euler argues that the internal force at a point M of a flexible thread can be found by imagining the lower part AM cut off and asking what force at M keeps the upper part BM in the same state, and he notes this force is unchanged if the thread is fixed at other points.

II. Quo istam vim puncto M quasi inhaerentem ex-
ploremus fingamus inferiorem partem AM reuera abscindi
et quaeramus eas vires, quas in puncto M applicari opor-
tet, vt pars superior BM in eodem plane statu perseue-
ret; haec enim ipsa vis ante recisionem in puncto M ex-
titisse est intelligenda, atque si hanc vim pro singulis fili
punctis determinauerimus, nullum est dubium quin verum
statum in quo singula elementa nostri fili versantur, per-
fecte cognoscamus.
III. Ponamus hanc ipsam vim quam quaerimus, iam
esse inuentam et puncto M reuera applicatam, ita vt re-
secta portione AM, altera portio BM etiamnunc in pristino
statu persistat, atque primum obseruo eandem hanc vim
ad filum BM in statuo suo retinendum requiri etiamsi in
puncto quocunque C, filum ope claui vel vnci figeretur,
siquidem haec operatio nihil in eius figura mutet, hocque
etiam intelligendum est, si filum simul in pluribus punctis
hoc modo figeretur; quare hoc etiam nunc locum habebit,
si filum adeo in puncto proximo $m$ figatur, nihilo enim
minus in puncto M eadem adhuc vi opus erit, ad con-
seruationem status ac si tota portio BM esset libera atque
in solo puncto B fixa. IV.

items.quote:
Quo istam vim puncto M quasi inhaerentem exploremus fingamus inferiorem partem AM reuera abscindi
et quaeramus eas vires, quas in puncto M applicari oportet, vt pars superior BM in eodem plane statu perseueret
items.english: In order to explore this force, as if inherent in the point M, let us imagine that the lower part AM is actually cut off, and let us seek the forces which must be applied at the point M so that the upper part BM remains in exactly the same state.

items.quote: atque si hanc vim pro singulis fili punctis determinauerimus, nullum est dubium quin verum statum in quo singula elementa nostri fili versantur, perfecte cognoscamus
items.english: And if we determine this force for each point of the thread, there is no doubt that we shall know perfectly the true state in which the individual elements of our thread are found.

items.quote: eandem hanc vim ad filum BM in statuo suo retinendum requiri etiamsi in puncto quocunque C, filum ope claui vel vnci figeretur
items.english: This same force is required to keep the thread BM in its state even if the thread were fixed at any point C by means of a nail or hook.

items.quote: si filum adeo in puncto proximo $m$ figatur, nihilo enim minus in puncto M eadem adhuc vi opus erit
items.english: Even if the thread is fixed at the very next point m, the same force will nonetheless still be needed at the point M.
